title: NukecacheConfig
description: Configuration schema for nukecache, nkc, and ncache cache cleanup tool.

$schema.description: URL to JSON schema for IDE autocompletion and validation.

defaultScope.description: Default cache scope inspected and displayed when no scope CLI flag is provided.

showGlobal.description: Whether global package manager targets should appear in interactive lists by default.

dryRun.description: Default to simulation/dry-run mode for cleanup operations in this project.

safe.description: Restrict default cleanup operations strictly to safe-tier caches.

force.description: Allow clearing rebuildable and global caches without requiring the --force CLI flag.

json.description: Default command outputs to structured JSON instead of formatted terminal text.

packageManagers.description: Explicitly restrict detected global package managers (e.g. ['pnpm'] or ['bun']).

days.description: Default age threshold (in days) used by the old command.

limit.description: Default maximum number of items ranked by the largest command.

noUpdateCheck.description: Disable the cached npm registry update check for this repository.

ignore.description: List of detector IDs, tool names (e.g. 'turbo', 'vite'), or exact relative paths to skip.

include.description: Additional project-relative directories to monitor as cache targets.

id.description: Unique identifier for this custom cache definition.

name.description: Display name of the custom cache target.

paths.description: Relative paths to cache directories or files.

safety.description: Safety tier of this cache target.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this cache target stores.

consequences.description: Notes or side effects when this cache is cleared.

custom.description: Custom detector definitions for proprietary tooling or internal build systems.
